messages:
elena (finance): Heads up — launching an Adaptive Surge Buffer (ASB) pilot + invoice summarization changes. Pilot replaces account-level soft-quota with per-route burst buckets that auto-redistribute to reduce noisy-neighbor overages and smooth charges for spiky workloads. Effective date: 2025-11-10. We'll pilot with a small cohort before broad opt-in. :loudspeaker:

matt (GTM): Nice — what's the customer-facing impact? Any change to free credits or how we communicate overages?

elena (finance): Good q. Free trial credits are moving from monthly slabs to a 90-day rolling window (same total credit, longer redemption window). Existing customers are grandfathered for 60 days to avoid surprise billing. We'll publish a migration guide + examples.

sam (eng-platform): Tech note: ASB enforcement is at the request-router. Burst consumption is deducted per-token. Batching, prefix caching, and KV cache unchanged. We'll emit new metrics: `burst_remaining`, `burst_ratio`, `burst_source`. ETA: Nov 3 infra rollout; Nov 10 opt-in pilot start.

anya (support): We'll need a clear FAQ, canned responses, and example invoices for customers and CS. Also special handling steps for Dedicated & Private tenants?

elena (finance): Yes — Dedicated customers get an opt-out toggle; Private (on-prem) will need a manual config change (we'll provide scripts). Example invoice snippet (summarized lines — this is the new recommended view):
```
INVOICE SUMMARY (example)
- model-family:gpt-redwood-1 | usage_tokens: 12,345 | burst_tokens: 1,000 | cost: $123.45
- route:chat/large          | usage_tokens: 8,765  | burst_tokens: 250   | cost: $87.65
TOTAL: $211.10
```

legal-bot: Contracts team note — we'll add a short "burst buffer" clause and a 60-day grandfathering amendment for customers on active SLAs. No retroactive price increases; just billing presentation and buffer mechanics.

deploy-bot: Announcement email scheduled 2025-10-20 16:00 UTC -> pilot cohort rollout notifications will go out then. Console banner scheduled for 2025-10-21.

anya (support): Can we get sample CSV exports for billing reconciliation? Also need UI tooltip copy for Console explaining burst tokens and redistribution. I'll compile top-10 customer questions to prep support training.

sam (eng-platform): Billing export schema will add flat fields: `burst_tokens`, `burst_source` (values: redistributed|direct), and `burst_window_start`. We'll provide migration scripts for analytics teams. Dedicated/on-prem note: ASB can be disabled; Private customers will receive a migration checklist.

matt (GTM): Marketing will draft a blog post and in-console explainer. Can folks share a 1-pager by Thursday so we can align copy and support materials?

elena (finance): Final operational notes: there will be a short promo period where redistributed burst usage is zero-cost for eligible startups (pilot cohort). Finance will track cost impact and report in weekly billing sync. Questions/escals -> DM me. :rocket:
